title: Computer Use in Claude Code (Pro/Max plans, March 2026)
description: Claude Code users on Pro and Max plans now have access to native computer use capabilities — Claude can open files, run dev tools, point, click, and navigate GUI elements to perform tasks directly on the user's screen. Distinct from: (1) the existing Bash tool (terminal-only control), (2) Better Playwright MCP (web browser only), (3) Terminator MCP (Windows-only third-party). This is first-party GUI automation integrated into the Claude Code session.
preliminary_notes: Needs verification: (1) exact version introduced, (2) whether available on Linux (requiem), (3) overlap with Better Playwright for web tasks, (4) how it differs from existing Bash + Better Playwright stack. If it enables native app GUI control (non-browser), that fills a genuine gap. If it's browser-only, overlap with Better Playwright is high.
registry_check: Not in registry. Terminator (Windows-only third-party MCP, 2026-03-23) is the closest but fundamentally different. Better Playwright covers web browser only. Native computer use for desktop GUI control is uncovered.
preliminary_score_range: 55-75/100 — depends on Linux availability and non-browser scope
